role: The hoe: tills grass or dirt into farmland when the side is not down and the cell above is air, with the farmland place sound and damageItem 1; carries its ToolMaterial durability and is furnace fuel as a wooden item.
scope_reason: Crops grow (villages are on, farming is vanilla); redstone is off but tilling needs no power.

members.note: the live use (server and client prediction) is itemuse.c:hoe_use: the canPlayerEdit gate, the side != 0 and air-above checks, the grass/dirt test; the client returns true untouched, the server writes the farmland and survival.c runs damageItem 1 through surv_damage_stack (the break draws, the break stat, the emptied slot). place.c:item_hoe_on_item_use is the placement probe's copy. iu-hoe-s1 (grass, dirt, a side face, under a block, from below, a worn-out hoe)
